ocr_excerpts: ch have thus far been sold for Phase II of the Earthquake Safety Program, the following five projects are completed: the De Young Museum Complex, Candlestick Park, Palace of Legion of Honor, Mission Branch Library, and the Department of Social Services (DSS) Office Building at 150 Otis Street. Also, Fire Station #1 has been previously completed under Phase I of the Earthquake Safety Bond Program. Ten projects have partial repairs completed: City Hall, Civic Auditorium, Davies Symphony Hall, War Memorial Opera House, Veteran's Building, Hall of Justice, Main Library, Youth Guidance Center and Marina Green Park and

e OES has determined that the seismic upgrading costs for City Hall are allowable. Therefore, the City may not receive any further reimbursements for these seismic upgrading costs through FEMA. In summary, the Earthquake Safety Bond Program has only completed approximately six major projects (including Fire Station #1 funded under Phase I of the Program) out of 23 projects identified, although all projects are reported to be on schedule by the DPW.
